text: Hey! Quick one — our March invoice (INV-40219) didn't show our VAT number even though we're registered in Ireland now. Could you add it going forward so our accountant stops flagging it? No rush at all. Also, love the new dashboard layout you shipped last week, way cleaner. Thanks!

So our Team plan renewal charged the card on file twice this month — $499 on the 3rd and another $499 on the 5th — even though I updated the payment method last week. It really feels like the payment system just didn't pick up the new card, so I can't tell if this is a refund situation or a sync glitch on your end. Either way I'd love the duplicate reversed and the card sorted out. Our finance lead Priya is asking questions and I've got no good answer for her yet. Thanks!

Hi there! The card on file for our Team plan (12 seats) expires at the end of the month, and the annual renewal is about $6,000 — I want to swap in a new card before it declines so we don't lose service. Can I pre-save a new payment method now, or does that only work after a failed charge? We really can't afford a lapse this quarter. Thanks!

Really need help on this one — we just got hit with a $12,400 charge for an Enterprise plan we never signed up for. We've always been on Team ($499/mo) and I have every invoice to prove it, going back two years. This is our actual company card, so I need it reversed today before it blows up our cash flow. Our ops director Marcus is on standby to confirm anything you need. Please treat this as a priority.

Hey, tiny thing — the extra report-scheduler add-on ($29/mo) auto-renewed for a month we didn't really use. Any chance that's refundable as a one-time courtesy? No pressure either way. Also, is there a way to turn off auto-renew on just the add-ons while keeping the main plan active? Thanks!

Our Shopify connector hasn't pulled a single order since Tuesday morning — the revenue dashboard is sitting at flat zero and it's wrecking my weekly report. I saw forum posts saying connectors get throttled on lower tiers, but we're on Team so I don't think that's it. Is this a sync outage, or do we actually need to upgrade a connector to get it working again? Either way I need those numbers back for a board deck Thursday. Thanks!

The REST API started throwing 502s on our nightly pull around 2am — roughly 30% of calls to /reports are failing, so our BigQuery load is now half stale. Dashboards and the mobile app seem fine otherwise. Could someone check the API status or logs? Not fully blocked, but our data's aging by the hour and I'd love a heads-up. Thanks!

Our entire dashboard is down — nobody on the team can load anything, just a spinner since around 8am, and we have a live client presentation at 1pm. The webhooks look dead too, since our Slack alerts stopped firing overnight. Is there an active outage? We're completely blocked and I'm scrambling here, so please help as fast as you can.

The Postgres connector has failed every sync for the last six hours with a 'connection timeout' error, so our revenue dashboard is stuck on yesterday's numbers. This is happening during a funding round week, and investors are literally watching these dashboards live. I've retried manually a dozen times with the same result. Can someone escalate this now? We're basically flying blind at the worst possible moment.

Not a huge deal but worth flagging — my scheduled Monday report still emails to an old work address, even though I updated my email in my profile about two weeks ago. Might just be a caching thing on your side? Low stakes, I forward it myself for now. The PDF exports also look a bit squished on mobile lately. No rush at all!

So I'm trying to switch on 2FA for my login, but the authenticator QR code won't scan on my iPhone — it just errors out. Is there a manual setup key I can type in instead? Not a rush, I can still get in with my password for now. Thanks!

Quick one — I got married and changed my last name, so I'd like to update my profile name and display email across our workspace. Do my report recipients automatically see the new name, or does that need changing separately? Just tidying things up before Q3 planning. Thanks so much!

I'm completely locked out after our IT rotated passwords overnight and the reset email never arrived — checked spam, nothing. On top of that, my 2FA device got wiped in a phone upgrade, so I can't verify that way either. I'm the workspace owner and can't access a single thing right now. Can you verify my identity and restore access today? This is blocking my entire team.

We just hired a new analyst, Dana, who starts Monday, and I'm trying to give her editor access to our workspace but the system won't let me add her without blowing past our seat limit. Do I need to buy an extra seat first, and can her access be provisioned today? We're on Team with all 12 seats full. I'd really like her productive on day one, so I'm a bit stuck on the right way to do this.

Our previous workspace owner left the company and I've been named the new owner, but the ownership transfer request is stuck on 'pending.' Can you help move ownership to me (Jenna Alvarez)? A bunch of admin controls are greyed out for me until it goes through. Not an emergency, but we're mid-project so sooner would be better. Thanks!

We're on the Team plan right now (12 seats) and seriously considering Enterprise, mainly for SSO and the audit logs. Could you send a formal quote for 25 seats billed annually? Our procurement team at Brightpath Media needs it in writing before end of week. Does Enterprise also bump up the Postgres connection limits? Thanks!

I'm building a shortlist of analytics tools for our marketing team and Lumen keeps coming up in the reviews. Could we book a 30-minute demo next week for around six people? We mostly care about the Salesforce connector and scheduled reports. I'm free Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon — thanks, looking forward to it!

We're trying to finalize our Enterprise contract before our fiscal quarter closes Friday to lock in the 15% discount your rep quoted us, but the paperwork with our procurement team at Northwind Labs keeps bouncing back. We're currently on monthly Team, billed per seat. Can someone from your side push this through today so we don't miss the window? The price genuinely goes up Monday, so this is time-sensitive for us. Thanks!

Just curious — do you offer a non-profit or early-stage startup discount on the Starter plan? We're a small four-person marketing shop mapping out next year's budget. No rush at all, just planning ahead. Thanks!

Does the Team plan include the mobile app for all seats, or is that a paid add-on? A couple of our field marketers would definitely use it. And what's the price difference between paying monthly versus annually for Team? Just gathering info for a budget doc, no timeline yet. Thanks!
Hi team — just wanted to say the new dashboard drill-down is genuinely fantastic, my whole group has been living in it daily. No request here, purely appreciation for the product folks. Keep it up! 😊

I run partnerships at a marketing-tech company called Kettle Analytics, and I think our audience data could plug neatly into Lumen's dashboards through the API. Would love to explore a co-marketing or integration partnership — who's the right person to loop in? No rush, just planting the seed. Really impressed with what you've built!

I'm a writer at MarTech Weekly working on a piece about B2B analytics platforms and would love a quick quote or comment from Lumen for it. Is there a press contact I can reach directly? The story goes live Thursday, so a response by tomorrow would be a big help. Thanks!

Hello! I noticed Lumen is hiring a marketing analyst and I'd love to apply — I've actually been using your product daily at my current job for two years and genuinely love it. Where should I send my resume? No rush, I just couldn't find a clear careers page. Thanks!

Is there a Lumen admin training webinar or a user community I could join? I've just become our workspace's main power user and want to get fluent in the advanced dashboard features before I start onboarding teammates next month. A calendar link or a resource list would be amazing. Thanks!
